# Security

This is a static site. It has no backend, no accounts, and stores nothing about visitors.
The only runtime state is in the page itself.

If you find something anyway — a dependency advisory that actually reaches the bundle, or
a way to get the deployed site to do something it should not — please report it privately
through GitHub's security advisories rather than opening a public issue:

https://github.com/ShrimpScript/abyss/security/advisories/new

Supported: the currently deployed `main`. There are no maintained older versions.
